status: SPECIFICATION_ONLY; implement strict validators and tests before use
machines: three separate computers; no automatic cross-account communication configured

runtime_roles.challenger: registered adversarial tests; no final/truth reads
runtime_roles.referee: deterministic protocol code, not LLM voting

numeric_semantics.statistics: float with nullable unsupported interval/p-value and explicit reason
numeric_semantics.prices_quantities_fees: Decimal/integer quote ticks with declared units; no trading or fee optimization
numeric_semantics.market_difference: forecast_probability minus an explicitly typed normalized quote; descriptive only, not profit

security.venue_operations: public/read-only GET; no funded orders or wallet signing
security.final_data: freeze/exposure audit/access log; do not claim historical data are untouched merely because files are sealed

adaptivity.final: finite family frozen before outcomes; post-exposure edits are new exploratory research
adaptivity.calibration: split by league/group; held-out family never tuned
adaptivity.trust: simulator-conditioned, no automatic real-NBA probability claim

final_unlock_policy.identity: one immutable final_family_id and final_epoch_id bound to code/config/record partition before unlock
final_unlock_policy.exposure_registry: persistent custodian ledger keyed to underlying record/game/group IDs, not only filenames or snapshot hashes
final_unlock_policy.transition: atomically reserve before work; mark spent before any labels/scores leave restricted evaluator
final_unlock_policy.overlap: new family IDs, renamed files or revised snapshots of exposed records cannot create a fresh confirmatory epoch
final_unlock_policy.retry: identical job replay/retry retains original identity/exposure receipt and is not a new final evaluation
final_unlock_policy.development_epoch: may be null for a development-only plan; final runs require valid reserved epoch

publication: No push/deployment/outside messages or paid signup authorised by this pack; current user permissions and official event rules govern
